definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of 原子爆弾. Refers to the nuclear fission bombs, especially those dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in 1945.

examples.japanese: {原爆|げんばく}が{投下|とうか}された。
{広島|ひろしま}の{原爆|げんばく}ドームを{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: I visited the Atomic Bomb Dome in Hiroshima.

examples.japanese: {原爆|げんばく}の{被害|ひがい}を{語|かた}り{継|つ}ぐことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to pass on stories of the damage caused by the atomic bomb.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原爆|げんばく}{投下|とうか} (atomic bomb dropping)
- {原爆|げんばく}ドーム (Atomic Bomb Dome, in Hiroshima)
- {原爆|げんばく}{被害者|ひがいしゃ} / {被爆者|ひばくしゃ} (atomic bomb victim/survivor)
- {原爆|げんばく}{資料館|しりょうかん} (Atomic Bomb Museum)

FORMS:
Abbreviation of {原子爆弾|げんしばくだん} (atomic bomb). This abbreviated form is the standard way to refer to atomic bombs in Japanese, especially in historical and memorial contexts relating to Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
